ftb.guhs_barbecuether.section.bestaand_w: The Watch at the Skewer Keep
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_woon_vi: Somewhere in the Guhbarbecuether stand the &6Mika Apartments&r: apartment blocks of grill iron with walkways, clotheslines and a smoking boiler house. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Mika Apartments) points the way. No monsters spawn there.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_mika_om: On the &dtop walkway&r of the tall block lives &6Granny Mika&r. She doesn't swipe nibbles: she knits and cooks sausage soup. Take the stairs in the west tower and say hello.
Bring a little bowl of soup to &cGrumble Mika&r (west block, ground floor), &cWhiny Mika&r (east block, two floors up) and &cSnore Mika&r (tall block, two floors up). Right-click them with the soup.
Granny Mika's knitting has blown off the walkway. It's on the &droof garden&r of the low east block: take the stairs in the east tower. Right-click the knitting basket.
Bring the knitting back to Granny Mika. She knits it into a cap right away, and from now on the Nether Mikas give you a &6discount&r: every third trade you get your ingot back.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_muts.de: A dark red cap with a cream-colored trim and two little knitted horns. Hold it (hold right-click) to unlock it, then put it on your guh in the wardrobe!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_korting: After Granny Mika's soup, trade three times with a &cNether Mika&r (give him a Wahoog Chonk Ingot): the third time he tosses your ingot back.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_stal_vi: The &6Mika Stable&r: a red barn with a muddy paddock, where the Mikas keep their &dSausage Piglets&r. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Mika Stable) knows one.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_stalkne: In front of the big stable door stands the &6Stable Hand Guh&r. A guh, working for the Mikas! Talk to him.
The Sausage Piglets are bouncing with nerves. &dPet&r three of them calm: right-click with an empty hand, three pets per piglet.
Empty the Stable Hand Guh's sack of &6piglet feed&r into the feeding trough, at the back of the stable aisle.

Oinky has escaped. Look for him near the paddock (behind the hay bales, by the cart or up in the hayloft), &dsneak&r up to him and pick him up. Bring him to the Stable Hand Guh: you get two Sausage Piglets in a basket!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_zwijntj: The Sausage Piglet in the Guhdex
Stand right next to a &dSausage Piglet&r: a little bratwurst on legs with a stripe of mustard down its back. It goes into your Guhdex.

Put the baskets down at home: your Sausage Piglets are farm critters. Petting, brushing (Guh Brush) and feeding (Nibble Feed or a filled feeding trough) makes them happy. With Nibble Feed they have little ones.
A &dhappy&r Sausage Piglet (two kinds of care in one day) sniffs something out for you every day: nibbles, little mushrooms, sometimes even something rare from the Barbecuether.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_brug_vi: The &6Mika Bridge Palace&r is a long toll bridge high above the sauce. You walk in through the open mouth of a gigantic Mika. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Mika Bridge Palace) points the way.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_tolwach: In the mouth sits the &cToll Keeper Mika&r. Talk to him.
Pay a toll of &68 cheese nibbles&r, or get &dthree riddles&r right. Guessed wrong? Then you simply get another riddle.
The bridge is broken (again). Lay the Toll Keeper's five planks in the gap: right-click with a plank, right by the gap. Fell in? Under the gap hangs a scaffold with a ladder.
Walk across the mended bridge to the bell tower and ring the &6toll bell&r. Hurry up: after a minute or so the planks drop out again.
Go back to the Toll Keeper Mika. From now on you always cross for free, and you get the &6blueprint&r of the bridge with planks and rope railing.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_raadsel: Get three of the Toll Keeper Mika's riddles right (instead of paying the toll). Nyeg nyeg nyeg!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.paleizen_brug_bo: With the &6blueprint&r in your crafting table you make &dMika Bridge Planks&r (planks and string) and &dRope Railing&r (sticks and string). The blueprint simply stays put.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bestaand_wachter: In the hall of every &6Skewer Keep&r there is a sentry box next to the statue. In it stands the &6Guard Guh&r: helmet on, skewer in his paw. Say hello (it startles him a little).
The Spark Mikas have blown out the bridge fires! On every bridge there is a brazier on a pedestal. Right-click all four with the Guard Guh's &6lighting skewer&r. Your fires keep burning for you.
All four fires are burning. Go tell the Guard Guh: he has one more little job.
The &dpeanut sauce garden&r (one staircase up, in the middle of the keep) is full of purple, prickly &5Mika Weed&r. Click each clump to pull it out.
Fires lit, garden tidy. Pick up your reward from the Guard Guh: the &blantern recipe&r, two Sad Little Lanterns and the guard outfit for your guh.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bestaand_lantaar: With the &blantern recipe&r in your crafting table (it stays put): 6 iron nuggets, glowcoal dust and light blue dye. The little lantern looks sad, until you pet it (right-click).
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bestaand_wachter: An iron helmet with a satay plume and a soot-black cloak with a glowing hem. Hold them (hold right-click) to unlock them for the wardrobe.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bestaand_knuffel: One floor up in every &cMika Grill Palace&r, next to the cages of stolen guh plushies, sits the &dPlushie Maker Guh&r in his sewing corner. He has to darn Mika socks. Talk to him (quietly).

Open the three cages. The ransom is &6one wahoog chonk&r per plushie (right-click the cage with it). Or &7sneak&r (crouch) and pick the lock while no Nether Mika is looking: three clicks. Caught? Then all you get is a shove. A Sneaky Nibble Potion helps!
The Mikas have been tugging at the plushies. Bring the Plushie Maker Guh &f4 string&r: you get three plushies and his &dplushie pattern&r.

With the &dplushie pattern&r in your crafting table you sew them yourself: 5 wool (pink, black or light gray) and a string. Collect the Plush Guh, the Plush Mika and the Plush Smoke Guh. Go on, give them a squeeze!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bestaand_sluiper: Pick a plushie cage open &7without paying&r and without a Nether Mika seeing you.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.fossiel_mijn_opg: Somewhere in the Guhbarbecuether the &dArchaeologist Guh&r is digging up the skeleton of a giant guh: the &6Fossil Dig&r. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Fossil Dig) points the way.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.fossiel_mijn_arc: Talk to the &dArchaeologist Guh&r by his tent. He gives you a &6Guh Dusting Brush&r.

With the Guh Dusting Brush, hold right-click on the &6bone sand&r in the pit (where a little tip of bone pokes out of the ash). Each spot gives you one bone; you need five bones. Everyone finds their own bones, even if someone has already dusted there.
Click the &6rack&r under the little roof with the bones. Only you see your skeleton grow.
Tell the Archaeologist Guh that it's standing! You get a &6Tyrannoguhrus Statuette&r and you may keep the brush.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.fossiel_mijn_dag: After the skeleton, every spot of bone sand holds something new for you each day: a little bone, some nibbles, sometimes a salt crystal. Dust one loose!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.fossiel_mijn_bee: Put your Tyrannoguhrus Statuette down somewhere everyone can see it.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.fossiel_mijn_mij: A white mountain full of crystals at the bottom of a cave: the &6Salt Crystal Mine&r. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Salt Crystal Mine) points the way.
Talk to the &dMineworker Guh&r by his little shed in front of the mine.
Chip five chunks of &6rubble&r off the cart track in the tunnels. (The rubble drops back after a minute or so for the next player: your five simply count.)
Follow the track all the way into the cave and chip at the pink &6crystal vein&r with a pickaxe.
Bring three salt crystals to the Mineworker Guh. You get his &6Salt Crystal Pickaxe&r: with it the vein gives twice as much.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.fossiel_mijn_zou: The crystal vein belongs a little bit to everyone: every player has their own supply in it, which grows back all by itself. Collect 16 &6salt crystals&r: Guh Technology with salt starts with those.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.fossiel_mijn_blo: Four salt crystals make a &6Salt Crystal Block&r: it gives off a soft light. Make a few.
Somewhere along the frying sauce sea stands a stable with a copper roof and two pink guh ears. That's where the &6Caretaker Guh&r lives with his &6Sauce Striders&r. Your &dSuper Compass&r points the way (Barbecue tab).
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sausdieren_sausl: Talk to the &6Caretaker Guh&r. He gives you &6Peanut Sauce on a Stick&r: every Sauce Strider goes wahoog chasing after that.
Hold the stick and lure a Sauce Strider out of the sauce basin to the Caretaker Guh. See him shiver on dry land? Cold little feet, nyeg.
Feed one of the stable's Sauce Striders three &6peanut sprouts&r. The Caretaker Guh gives you the first three. After that it trusts you.
Ask for your test ride. A saddled Sauce Strider comes to the dock, just for you. Hop on, hold the stick and ride through the four little gates. He walks wherever you look.
Pick up your &6saddle&r from the Caretaker Guh. From now on the wild Sauce Striders on the sauce sea dare to come up to you too.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sausdieren_eigen: Find a wild &6Sauce Strider&r on the frying sauce sea and feed him peanut sprouts until he gives hearts. Saddle on, stick in your hand: now you cross the sauce sea just like that. Sneak and click to make him wait.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sausdieren_loper: Look at a &6Sauce Strider&r from up close: then he's in your &dGuhdex&r.
After the lesson the Caretaker Guh times every lap. Reach the finish in &6thirty seconds&r or less. Tip: right-click with the stick for a little sprint.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sausdieren_blubj: &6Sauce Blubbies&r bounce around the Guhbarbecuether: blobs of sauce with a little crust and a snoot. Look at one from up close for your &dGuhdex&r. They don't do a thing, they just blub.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sausdieren_knuff: Give a big Sauce Blubby a cuddle (right-click with an empty hand) or a cheese nibble. It's so happy it splits into two smaller blubbies.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sausdieren_blubr: Every time a Sauce Blubby splits, it leaves a dollop of &6blub cream&r behind. Three nibbles make a small blubby grow a size again, so a pen of blubbies keeps on blubbing. Can't find a blubby? The &6Caretaker Guh&r of the Sauce Strider Stable sends his students home with one in a jar every day.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sausdieren_potje: A &6small&r Sauce Blubby fits exactly into a glass bottle (right-click). That's how you take it home. The Inventor Guh surely knows what to do with it too...
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sausdieren_stuit: Stir blub cream into a pot of cheese broth in the &6Guh Brewing Cauldron&r and tap a &6Bouncy Potion&r. For three minutes you don't fall anymore: you bounce. Sneaking is landing.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.camping_markt_ca: Somewhere in the Guhbarbecuether there's a whole village of little tents around a big campfire: the &6Grill Campground&r. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Grill Campground) points the way.
Talk to the &dCamp Boss Guh&r at the reception (the little house with the pointed roof). He gives you a &6tent bag&r.

Click a green &6VRIJ&r (vacant) sign with the tent bag (on the yellow grass by the gate) and then hammer in the four &6stakes&r of your tent: click the iron pegs. A tent on every spot already? They pop back into the bag by themselves after a few minutes.
Ask the &dLumberjack Guh&r by the woodshed for firewood and click a &6chopping block&r six times. You get a bundle of firewood.
Toss the bundle of firewood onto the &6big campfire&r in the middle of the campground. The camper guhs come sit around it and start dancing!

Pick up the &6Roasting Stick&r from the Camp Boss Guh. Hold right-click on the burning campfire and let go when the marshmallow is &6golden brown&r (too early is cold, too late is black: then you just try again). Three golden brown ones, and go tell him: you get the &dcamping outfit&r and the &6Plantation Box recipe card&r.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.camping_markt_bu: Five camper guhs live at the campground. Click one for a little chat. (They belong to the campground: you can't tame them.)
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.camping_markt_st: The Roasting Stick works over &6any&r burning campfire, at home and in the daytime too. Roast one golden brown! (You need marshmallow nibbles: stick + sugar + cheese nibble.)
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.camping_markt_te: From &6tent canvas&r (wool + string) you build your own tent: the sloped pieces are the roof. Make eight sloped pieces in a color of your choice.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.camping_markt_ma: Striped stalls around a big tent with a scale: the &6Nether Mika Barter Market&r. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Nether Mika Barter Market) points the way.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.camping_markt_ru: Talk to the &dMarket Master Mika&r on his podium in front of the Weigh House.

Talk to him again and haggle him down from 30 to 10 nibbles. Read carefully what he says: if he &6brags&r, give a compliment; if he &6sighs&r, offer low; if he &6growls&r about his final offer, pretend to walk away. Three mistakes and he sends you off (then you just start over).

In the Weigh House lie five stacks of chonk. One is &6fake&r, and fake chonk is lighter. Click two stacks to weigh them; then click the fake one with the &6Seal of Approval&r. (Which one is fake is different for everyone. Stamped the wrong one? Then the trickster swaps them around.)
Go tell the Market Master Mika. You get the &6scale&r, and from now on a little extra with every trade with a Nether Mika.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.camping_markt_kr: The &dStall Mikas&r of the market trade right away: give one an ingot of &6wahoog chonk&r and you get your surprise. No sniffing around, and they leave you be.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.camping_markt_ex: After the questline, trade with a Nether Mika (at the market or in the wild, by putting the ingot in his paw): you get a second little present on top.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.camping_markt_ko: Every day you can haggle with the Market Master Mika again. If you win, you get the deal of the day.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_tore: Somewhere in the smoke stands a red-and-white tower with two pink guh ears on its roof. That's where the &6Lighthouse Keeper Guh&r lives. His lamp is out... Your &dSuper Compass&r points the way (Barbecue tab).
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_vuur: Talk to the &6Lighthouse Keeper Guh&r. Without a light the Smoke Guhs can't find their way home anymore.
Bring him four &6glowcoal dust&r (break glowcoal to bits). He presses it into a &6Lamp Ember&r, and you may borrow his &6Signal Lantern&r.
Climb the spiral stairs, all the way up into the glass lamp room, and put the Lamp Ember in the lamp. TOOOOT!

Around the tower float three skinny &6Lost Smoke Guhs&r, just for you (with a little star above them). Walk up to them with the Signal Lantern in your paw: they float along behind you until they see the light. Feeding them six cheese nibbles works too.
Go back to the Lighthouse Keeper Guh. You get a &6Delivery Guhling Whistle&r and a &6lighthouse keeper's coat&r for your guh.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_flui: The &6Delivery Guhling Whistle&r calls the Delivery Guhling of your own Scooter Station over to you. Sneak and whistle to send them all home. Lost it? The Lighthouse Keeper Guh carves a new one every day.
A dark blue coat with golden buttons and a red-and-white collar. Hold it (hold right-click) to unlock it, then put it on your guh in the wardrobe!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_lamp: Make your own &6Lighthouse Lamp&r (grill iron bars, glass and glowcoal). It fwoops on as soon as someone nearby has lit the real lighthouse. That's you.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_tuin: A glass greenhouse in the middle of the Guhbarbecuether, with a garden full of peppers beside it and a guh scarecrow. That's where the &6Pepper Grower Guh&r lives. Your &dSuper Compass&r points the way (Barbecue tab).
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_pepe: Talk to the &6Pepper Grower Guh&r. He gives you three &6pepper seeds&r.
In the greenhouse there are three &6grow boxes&r. Plant a seed in each box, wait until your little plant is ripe and pick it. Your plants are yours alone.

Brew your first &6pepper potion&r in the Guh Brewing Cauldron at the back of the greenhouse: powder, cheese sauce, stir in a red or pink pepper and fill a bottle. The Pepper Grower Guh gives you everything you need.
Let the Pepper Grower Guh have a taste. You get &6seeds&r for home, the &6other potion&r and a &6pepper garland&r for your guh.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_pluk: You pick a ripe pepper plant with a &6right-click&r: the plant stays where it is and simply keeps growing. Try it in the display beds of the greenhouse.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_thui: Plant pepper seeds on &6Ash Dirt&r (green Nyeg Pepper), &6Glowcoal&r (red Wahoog Pepper) and &6Peanut Sauce Nylium&r (pink Candy Pepper). Put &bglass&r above them: then they grow three times as fast. You get seeds when you dig up a ripe plant.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_pepe: Cheese broth with a &cWahoog Pepper&r. For three minutes you chop and dig like wildfire, with little flames from your snoot (&6Pepper Breath&r: you'll never be cold again).
Cheese broth with a &dCandy Pepper&r. A warm, sweet feeling: you heal a little and get two extra hearts.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_heet: Eat a &craw Wahoog Pepper&r. It makes you run wahoog for ten seconds, with smoke coming out of your ears. Nobody said it was smart, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.toren_peper_slin: A garland of red, green and pink peppers. Hold it (hold right-click) to unlock it, then hang it around your guh in the wardrobe!
